IN THE DISTRICT COURT OF HARRIS COUNTY
Rosa Delgado, Plaintiff, v. Delgado Freight LLC, Defendant.
COMPLAINT
1. Plaintiff Rosa Delgado is an individual residing in Harris County.
2. Defendant Delgado Freight LLC ("Delgado Freight") is a limited liability company. Its managing member is Marco Delgado, Plaintiff's former husband.
3. Ms. Delgado worked for the company as a dispatcher from 2019 until March 2024, when Mr. Delgado dismissed her without notice.
4. Plaintiff retained Rosa Delgato, a local attorney. Attorney Delgato wrote to Delgado Freight demanding the unpaid wages; the managing member did not reply.
5. Defendant has refused to pay the wages owed. WHEREFORE, Plaintiff asks the Court to enter judgment against the company.
Respectfully submitted, Plaintiff's counsel.

Millbrook United 2-1 Ashford Town
Millbrook United came from behind to beat Ashford Town on Saturday. The visitors led at half-time through their captain, Tom Ashworth, who curled in a free kick. Tom Ashford, the hosts' striker, levelled with a header on the hour and then won it with a penalty in stoppage time. Despite his name, the striker has no connection to Ashford Town. Ashworth said afterwards: "We gave it away." The striker's father, Graham Ashford, is the Millbrook United manager. The manager said Tommy, as the squad call him, had been ill all week. The hosts move up to fifth; the visitors stay bottom.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Harlan Group plc ("Harlan" or "the Group") today announced a definitive agreement to acquire Harland Systems Inc. ("Harland Systems"), a maker of warehouse robotics, for $240 million in cash. Peter Harlan, Chairman of the Group and grandson of its founder, said the deal "doubles our engineering base". Mr. Harlan will also join the board of the combined business. The target's CEO, Petra Harland, will stay on to run the business as a division of the Group; Ms. Harland founded the company in 2011. The CEO said customers would see no change. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to approval by Harland Systems shareholders. Harlan was advised by Brook & Co.; the target was advised by its own counsel. The Chairman declined to comment on further acquisitions.
